Name: The GTM Co-Founder
Tagline: Open-source GTM skills for technical founders
Description: Most AI hands dev-tool founders the same generic sales and marketing advice. The GTM Co-Founder doesn't. It's a set of open-source skills that interview you once, learn your real product and market, then walk you move by move through a prioritised GTM roadmap: who it's for, positioning, your first 50 users, launch, pricing, etc. Grounded in the playbooks of Adam Frankl and Jakub Czakon, plus my own time as a Founding AE and GTM advisor. Free and open source.

Name: AstraPixels
Tagline: ​​A pixel-art solar system at its real current positions.​
Description: An animated pixel-art map of the solar system with every body at its real current position, computed from published orbital elements rather than copied from a list. Zoom from the Sun to the Kuiper belt, browse 171 catalogued objects with sourced facts, and see what the sky is doing for the next six months. Every rock is also for sale: claim an asteroid for $5, keep it forever, name it whatever you like. A name here is shown on AstraPixels only, and is not an IAU designation.

Name: Basedash Subscriptions
Tagline: Subscribe to any dashboard. Delivered on schedule.
Topics: Artificial Intelligence, Data & Analytics, Business Intelligence
Description: Subscribe to any Basedash dashboard or chart and get a fresh snapshot delivered on a schedule—straight to your inbox or a Slack channel. Pick the cadence (every Monday at 9am, daily, monthly on the 1st), choose who receives it, and each delivery arrives with up-to-date charts and a link back to the live dashboard. No exporting, no screenshotting, no remembering to share. The Monday metrics email your team wants, without anyone building it. Your dashboards, delivered on schedule.

Name: Hexis
Tagline: Git-backed skills, tools & context for AI agents
Description: One place where your company's AI skills, tools and knowledge live - centrally managed, reviewed and access-controlled, and usable from any AI agent. Hexis is a layer on top of Git: same core (versioning, PRs), plus a clean UX so anyone can use skills, suggest changes, and submit new ones and admins can govern which context, tools, and skills each person, team, or agent can access. Consumed via MCP, works in any agent in the company.

Name: Toolport
Tagline: Every tool, one port. One MCP setup for all your AI agents
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: A free, open source, local MCP gateway. Set up each server once and every AI agent shares it (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, and 29 more). Instead of dumping every tool definition into context, it exposes a few meta-tools your agent searches on demand. Benchmarked and graded for correct answers, that's up to 91% fewer tokens at the same task success. Secrets live in your OS keychain, not client configs. Rug-pulls and tool poisoning get flagged, and destructive calls can wait for your approval.

Name: Patch — Your Security Center
Tagline: Lock down your digital life and stay on top of it.
Description: Patch is a security app for Mac and iPhone (in App Store review) designed for people who'd rather not bounce around a dozen scary-looking tools trying to deal with online security. It checks for scams, finds leaked and duplicate passwords, helps freeze your credit and remove you from data broker sites, all in one place, with a security advisor that answers questions and shows you how to fix things. No account needed, and nothing is kept on our servers, so there's nothing to steal.

Name: VoiceDumps
Tagline: Hold the globe key. Talk. The words appear at your cursor.
Description: Local speech to text for macOS. Hold the globe key, talk, and the words land at your cursor in whatever app you were already in. Or drop in audio and video for transcripts with real timestamps. Free, MIT, and fully offline — the models ship inside the app.

Name: Pinpoint Answer Today
Tagline: Practice five-clue Pinpoint puzzles without spoilers
Description: Pinpoint Answer Today turns a growing archive of five-clue word-association puzzles into a spoiler-controlled practice experience. Reveal clues one at a time, make your category guess, then compare your reasoning with clue-by-clue explanations. It is free in the browser, searchable, and built for players who want practice—not an answer dumped in the first sentence. Independent and not affiliated with LinkedIn.

Name: Pesterly
Tagline: Automated client document collection that follows up for you
Description: Pesterly is a document collection tool for Google Workspace that turns a checklist of files into an email request, chases whatever is still missing on a fixed schedule, and saves every upload into a folder in your own Google Drive.

Name: Arbyn
Tagline: AI support agent for Shopify that acts on your orders
Description: Arbyn is an AI support and sales agent for Shopify. It answers support email and live chat in your store's voice, updates shipping addresses on its own, and handles refunds, cancellations, discounts, gift cards, reships and returns after you approve them with one tap. Free plan with 150 AI conversations a month. $99 a month flat for unlimited. No per ticket fees.

Name: Supabase RLS Leak Demo
Tagline: Reproduce a cross-tenant RLS leak and verify the fix
Description: A tiny, runnable Supabase/Postgres security fixture that proves a policy can look correct and still leak rows across tenants. The same test suite runs red on the broken policy and green after the one-file fix. Start with npm ci && npm test—no Docker, cloud project, credentials, or production data required. Built for founders and developers who want evidence before shipping multi-tenant apps.

Name: Scoret
Tagline: Guess the secret number, crush your friends.
Description: Welcome to Scoret, a lightning-fast multiplayer guessing duel. 🎮 How it works: Player A locks in a secret number (1-100). Player B tries to guess it. Get real-time temperature feedback (from 🧊 FREEZING to 🔥 SUPER HOT). Guess it fast to earn max points before you run out of rounds! ⚡ The Features: • Zero Friction: Share a 6-digit code, play instantly in-browser. • Solo Mode: No friends around? Challenge the bot. • Neon UI: Real-time feedback, responsive design, and victory confetti.

Name: twoHelixes
Tagline: Make graphs about your data with AI
Description: Ask for a chart of any data you have - a spreadsheet, a database, a warehouse - and get one back in seconds, correct and readable.

Name: PolyTake
Tagline: Everyone Films. One Movie.
Description: Turn any event into a movie you make together. Your friends film along, you collect every angle, and PolyTake cuts it automatically. For iPhone.

Name: lovelisti
Tagline: List everything you love. find the people who love it too.
Description: lovelisti — share and discover what you love

Name: Buyer Thoughts
Tagline: See what other buyers think before you buy on Amazon
Description: Buyer Thoughts adds a tiny bar to Amazon product pages showing what other shoppers think — before you buy. Answer three one-click questions: Would you buy this? Worth the price? Does it look trustworthy? No account, no review to write. New products show a disclosed estimate from Amazon's own rating instead of "0 votes." 100% anonymous — no name, email, or order data ever read. Free, works instantly.

Name: AWS Marketplace Developer Kit
Tagline: Node.js library for Developers building SaaS products on AWS
Description: Self-hosted Node.js gateway that handles customer onboarding, authentication, entitlement gating, and usage metering for your AWS Marketplace SaaS listing. Source included. Runs in your VPC.

Name: rating.so
Tagline: Monitor your Domain Rating, every single day.
Description: rating.so is a Domain Rating monitor: daily DR & backlink tracking, instant Email & Slack alerts, and a free public DR report for any domain. Free to start.

Name: Habitu
Tagline: Loyalty cards in Apple & Google Wallet, no app needed
Description: Habitu gives local shops a loyalty card that lives in Apple Wallet and Google Wallet. Customers join in 5 seconds, no app to download. Free proximity notifications, AI-written campaigns, Google reviews on autopilot. Built in France for neighborhood businesses. From EUR 0.

Name: AIUsageBar
Tagline: Track every AI limit from your Mac menu bar
Topics: Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, Menu Bar Apps
Description: AIUsageBar is a native macOS menu bar app that tracks usage, rate limits, reset windows, and spend across Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot, and 47+ AI tools.
